mapper.sql: SELECT c.*, e.emp_no, e.name AS employee_name, e.status AS emp_status, d.name AS dept_name FROM hr_contract c JOIN hr_employee e ON e.id = c.employee_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = e.dept_id
mapper.select: WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.end_date IS NOT NULL AND c.end_date <= #{before} ORDER BY c.end_date
